title: aristolochia longa subsp. pallida
intro: Aristolochia longa subsp. pallida, commonly known as the pale Dutchman's pipe, is a plant species in the Aristolochiaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat a range of health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The health benefits of Aristolochia longa subsp. pallida are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which are due to its bioactive constituents, such as aristolochic acids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. However, it's worth noting that the plant also contains aristolochic acid, a known nephrotoxin, and its use should be approached with caution and under the guidance of a healthcare professional.
